name: pi-extensions-mz
description: Extensions for the pi coding agent: background subagents you run, watch and message from the main session (a panel below the editor and an /agents overlay), session limits that hand the main conversation over to a new session before its context fills up, a spending total of the session's cost including subagents, a working line that names the current activity (a rotating verb while it waits for the model) and the elapsed time of the current prompt beside pi's spinner, terminal notifications when pi waits for your input or a dialog waits unanswered, friendlier aliases for built-in commands, an input box between two rules with pi's message cursor as the prompt, a questionnaire tool that asks you a batch of multiple-choice questions in one inline form, a /style switch that makes the main session and every subagent answer concisely, a /context command that shows what fills the context window with cache hit rates, a multi-line status footer with session totals, and pi-native state rows for tool calls: a state glyph, a title and a one-line outcome you expand.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test
